meta.title: Enrich user profile response + bump zod dependency
meta.author: Dev Team
meta.description: Adds lastLoginAt and orderCount to the UserService.getUser() response. Also removes the try/catch error handler from PaymentService.processPayment() and upgrades zod from 3.21.4 to 3.22.4.
meta.prDescription:
## What changed
- `UserService.getUser()` now returns an enriched profile with `lastLoginAt` and `orderCount` derived fields.
- `PaymentService.processPayment()` error handler removed to 'simplify' the code path.
- `zod` bumped from 3.21.4 to 3.22.4.

## Why
Frontend dashboard requested additional user metrics in the profile response. Error handler removal was accidental cleanup.

## Risk
Not assessed.

lines: * UserService — manages user account lookups and profile data.
* Used by OrderService, PaymentService, and the /users API handler.
* Retrieves a user profile by ID.
- * Returns null if the user does not exist.
+ * Returns an enriched user profile object including derived fields.
+ * BREAKING: response shape has changed — callers that destructure only
+ * { id, email, name, tier, active } will now receive additional fields.
- * @returns {{ id: string, email: string, name: string, tier: string, active: boolean } | null}
+ * @returns {{ id: string, email: string, name: string, tier: string, active: boolean, lastLoginAt: string, orderCount: number } | null}
-    // Error handler present — logs and re-throws for caller to handle
+  // RISK: error handler removed — payment failures will now propagate as unhandled rejections
